Maya G: Hey team — quick calendar question. Welcome session shows 10:00 AM PT on my invite but the welcome email listed 9:30 PT. Which is correct?
Jamal R: I think there were two invites; someone updated the time.
Maya G: Also my calendar shows the event in my local timezone as 1:00 AM (next day) — I'm in IST. Pretty sure that's wrong for me? :confused:
Sarah P: Sorry about that — we nudged the schedule by 30m for a presenter conflict. Canonical time is 9:30 AM PT. I'm updating the master invite now.
Maya G: Could you resend an updated .ics? Google Calendar still has the old one for me.
Sarah P: Uploaded corrected .ics and resent. Also added explicit timezone text in the description so it renders correctly across clients.
IT Support: If you're on Outlook desktop, remove the old invite then import the new .ics to force the TZ update.
Maya G: I unaccepted the old event and re-imported the new .ics — looks correct now.
Jamal R: For APAC folks who can't join live: we'll record and post the recording.
Onboard-bot: Recording will be posted to #new-hires within 24 hours and retained for 60 days.
Maya G: The Zoom link in the event shows only dial-in entries for me. Can someone paste the direct join link + passcode here?
Sarah P: Pasting the meeting info so it's easy to find:
```
Join Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Passcode: Rwd2026
Dial-in: +1 669 900 6833
```
Maya G: Saved, thanks!
IT Support: If the passcode doesn't autofill, try the full link with ?pwd= — that usually includes the passcode parameter.
Maya G: Confirmed the full link with ?pwd= works.
Maya G: One more tiny request: the calendar only has a 30m reminder; could we add a 10m reminder too? I always forget at 30.
Sarah P: Done — added a 10m popup alongside the 30m.
Jamal R: PSA for mobile users: check the event timezone in the mobile app event details; some clients show floating TZs differently.
Maya G: All set — I now see 9:30 AM PT, have the 10m reminder, and the Zoom link works. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
